page_title: MAI 1-1 WOL | Mainz v Wolfsburg 13/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Niko Kovac has decided to make a change. Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) replaces Lovro Majer.
90+2' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Koen Casteels intercepts the ball.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
88' The referee allows time for a substitution. Phillipp Mwene will be replaced by Maxim Leitsch (Mainz).

88' What a great chance for Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header right under the bar, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
87' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Wolfsburg comes to nothing.
85' 54:46 – the ratio of ball possession.
81' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
79' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
78' Jan Siewert prepares a substitution. Tom Krauss is replaced by Leandro Barreiro (Mainz).
78' Substitution. Jonathan Burkardt walks off the pitch and Marco Richter (Mainz) comes on as a substitute.
76' Mainz have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
74' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mainz.
71' That will be all from Vaclav Cerny who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg).
71' Substitution. Aster Vranckx makes his way off the pitch and Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) comes on as his replacement.
71' Niko Kovac has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) replacing Jakub Kaminski.
67' Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
66' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicolas Cozza trots off the pitch and is replaced by Rogerio (Wolfsburg).
62' Here is a change. Merveille Papela is going off and Jan Siewert gives the last tactical orders to Brajan Gruda (Mainz).
61' 1 - 1 Silvan Widmer (Mainz) latches on to a superb pass and breaks through the defence before firing a shot from mid-range that goes past the goalkeeper inside the left post.
57' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Patrick Ittrich had an easy-decision to make.
56' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg), but it's just wide of the left post.
56' Wolfsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
54' Koen Casteels (Wolfsburg) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
54' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
51' Merveille Papela (Mainz) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Patrick Ittrich saw the whole situation.
49' Robin Zentner (Mainz) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
48' Robin Zentner (Mainz) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
46' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Patrick Ittrich has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) dribbles into the box, but Robin Zentner is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
45+2' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' A wild pass somehow finds Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
42' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
39' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
37' Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
35' Mainz fail to score from a corner as Koen Casteels (Wolfsburg) leaps to collect the ball.
33' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) commits a rough foul. Patrick Ittrich stops the game and makes a call.
32' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Phillipp Mwene (Mainz).
30' The corner is swung in but Wolfsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
27' Patrick Ittrich shows a yellow card to Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) for his blatant foul.
25' Nicolas Cozza (Wolfsburg) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
22' Mainz take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
20' Mainz failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
19' The resulting set piece from Mainz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
17' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) was quite harsh and Patrick Ittrich didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
16' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Dominik Kohr (Mainz) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
14' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle for a foul.

12' 0 - 1 Goal! Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box inside the right post. Robin Zentner had no chance of reaching it. The score is 0:1.
10' An attempted cross from Nicolas Cozza (Wolfsburg) is cleared.
8' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
7' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mainz comes to nothing.
5' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
3' Yellow card. Silvan Widmer (Mainz) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
3' Patrick Ittrich couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Silvan Widmer (Mainz) and blew his whistle.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Mainz will kick-off.
Patrick Ittrich was nominated as the referee for this game.
